Let \(n=2012\). The product is
\[
4(10^n-1)^2=(4\cdot 10^n-8)10^n+4.
\]
Decimal subtraction gives the numerator
\[
4(10^n-1)^2 = 3\underbrace{99\ldots 9}_{n-1}2\underbrace{00\ldots 0}_{n-1}4.
\]
Dividing by \(9\) gives
\[
\frac{4(10^n-1)^2}{9}
=
\underbrace{44\ldots 4}_{n-1}3\underbrace{55\ldots 5}_{n-1}6.
\]
So the digit sum is
\[
4(n-1)+3+5(n-1)+6=9n.
\]
With \(n=2012\),
\[
9\cdot 2012=18108.
\]
\[
\boxed{18108}
\]
